scenarios.label: Mismos costes; sin mínimo de recall

scope: Sensitivity extension, same historical development folds; not new validation. Cost changes and recall floors are engineering hypotheses, not new teacher requirements.
pool: 40 historical singles and all 2340 weighted pairs. Threshold exhaustive over inner score breakpoints plus no-alert option. No new base fits.
selection: Choose cost/model/weights/threshold with inner only; evaluate outer afterward; report RF, selected single and selected pair. No blind-test or runtime changes.
representation: Same original sensors + type and historical configurations/physical ablations; no new measured variables or failure labels as features.
